### Compatibility

Mirrors renderPriceCardMeta over renderMetaInline: title/label/heading/name (default Price), Model model/pricingModel and Interval interval/billingInterval inline terms. Children replace the entire body including its title. modelField and intervalField lower to their runtime keys. amountField, currencyField and minorUnitsParameter are consumed unbound because this HTML metadata renderer has no amount or currency term. Noninteractive.
